name: TownePlace Suites (Draper, UT) Freshly Griddled Belgian Waffle & Maple Syrup
brandOrRestaurant: TownePlace Suites Salt Lake City Draper
whyItWorks: Made fresh in the hotel lobby waffle iron. Golden, fluffy, and tender interior with zero seeds, nuts, or roughage. Highly digestible carbohydrate energy for travel days.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour batter into the rotating waffle maker until golden; top with pure maple syrup and a pat of butter (skip strawberry toppings with seeds).
watchOuts: Avoid fruit compote toppings containing whole berry seeds
